{{Quote|I'm reading a power surge in the cruiser's missile array.|[[Jinkins]] to [[Nym/Legends|Nym]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''</ref>}}
The '''Trade Federation Cruiser''' was a type of wedge-shaped [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] utilized by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The cruiser possessed several laser cannons but used [[cruise missile]]s as its primary weapons. One was [[Battle of Lok (22 BBY)|destroyed]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] by the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]].

==Characteristics==
The cruiser was wedge-shaped in appearance, with gray hull plates and a ridge along the rear of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. The ship's primary weapons were its banks of [[cruise missile]]s, while the rest of its hull was lined with several laser cannons.

==History==
{{Quote|Nym, that cruiser is right above the base!|[[Kole]] to Nym|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], one such vessel was used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to attack the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], who were struggling for [[Occupation of Karthakk|control]] of the [[Karthakk system]]. The pirates were [[Battle of Lok (22 BBY)|besieging]] an installation on the [[Khons]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. The cruiser came out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and commenced launching a series of cruise missiles at the pirates. At the time, the pirates were constructing an [[Orbital Defense Cannon]] for use against surface targets. Despite a glitch in the cannon's targeting system, the pirates were able to destroy the cruiser before it could destroy the cannon.

==Behind the scenes==
This cruiser first appeared in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''.

It is unknown if this vessel and the [[Trade Federation escort cruiser]] are of the same class. They both exist in the same era and are of similar name and role, but are never confirmed as the same ship.
